jobs.title: Do Cats ALWAYS Land on Their Feet? 🌀 #Swirlverse
jobs.description:
Do cats always land on their feet? Almost! A falling cat bends in the middle, tucks its front paws, spins its front half, then swaps and spins the back half. But in this parallel world, cats can't bend... 🐱
Bendy cats or stiff cats? Comment below 👇

Real science: the cat righting reflex. The front and back halves turn in opposite directions, so the total spin (angular momentum) stays zero. It needs a super flexible spine. It isn't guaranteed: a very short drop is too quick to turn. Sources: Scientific American, Live Science.

#shorts #science #cats #physics #animals #swirlverse

jobs.first_comment:
Real fact 🐱 A falling cat spins its front half one way and its back half a little the other way, so its total spin stays zero, and it still ends up feet down!

Which world do you pick? 🅰️ Bendy cats  🅱️ Stiff cats 👇
